articles.title: Home Assistant cuts startup stalls caused by long sensor histories
articles.dek: Replaying an averaging sensor’s readings can hold up startup for minutes and prevent other integrations from loading.
body: Home Assistant stops a long sensor-averaging window from holding up startup while it replays recorded readings. In a reported setup with a 24-hour window and a reading every five seconds, that replay delayed startup for six to seven minutes—long enough for the global timeout to cancel ZHA and other integrations.

Franck Nijhof replaces repeated scans of the full window with a running total. Replaying 16,945 readings took 0.08 seconds instead of 34.76 seconds on his test machine. Those measurements describe the replay itself, rather than the full startup reported by the affected user; comparisons with the old calculation found unchanged results.

pullRequests.title: Fix filter time moving average walking its whole window on every sample

articles.title: UniFi Protect adds more controls without a local user account
articles.dek: API-key-only connections gain switches for cameras, floodlights and smart sensors, plus relay outputs.
body: Home Assistant expands what a UniFi Protect connection can control using only an API key. Camera status lights, overlays and smart-detection settings join floodlight status lights, smart-sensor detection switches and relay outputs, without requiring the additional local user account used by full-access mode.

Raphael Hehl builds on the existing API-key-only connection. Smart sensors become available in that mode and relays gain full support, while settings absent from UniFi’s public interface still require full access. Relays adopted after setup are also discovered automatically.

articles.title: Sofar stops reporting household energy it never measured
articles.dek: Affected inverters lose six misleading sensors, which need removing from dashboards and automations.
body: Home Assistant stops publishing household consumption and grid import and export readings when a Sofar inverter reports that the required meter data is invalid. On one solar-only 4.4 KTLX-G3, the supposed consumption total copied solar generation and claimed 17.9 MWh that the household had never consumed.

The correction removes the daily and total readings for all three measures on affected installations. People using those sensors need to remove them from Energy dashboards, templates or automations. Inverters that report valid meter data keep the readings, including solar-only systems with a meter; models that provide no usable validity information are unchanged. Solar generation sensors keep reporting.

articles.title: Plexamp finds Music Assistant players that local discovery misses
articles.dek: Optional Plex account linking gives affected iPhone setups another way to find a playback destination.
body: Music Assistant adds an optional way to make its Plex Connect players appear in Plexamp on iPhones that cannot find them locally. Linking the player to a Plex account makes it discoverable through Plex’s device registry; networks where local discovery already works do not need the extra step.

Mark Johnson tested the approach on an affected network, where the player appeared within seconds and responded to playback, queue and volume controls. Unlinked players make no requests to plex.tv, and an unreachable Plex service does not prevent the plugin from starting.
Removing the plugin may leave its registration behind, so the account’s Authorized Devices page may need a manual cleanup. This is Johnson’s first contribution to the Music Assistant server.

articles.title: Home Assistant downloads SVG media to stop embedded scripts running
articles.dek: Directly opening local SVG media becomes a download, while ordinary image displays keep working.
body: Home Assistant changes how it serves locally stored SVG images when someone opens a file’s own address. The browser downloads the file instead of opening it as an active document, preventing embedded scripts from running on the same site as the Home Assistant interface.

Franck Nijhof preserves SVGs used as ordinary images in picture cards and thumbnails. Media folders can receive files from installed apps, snapshot actions, downloads and automations as well as uploads; the safeguard applies when directly opening an SVG from those folders.

articles.title: Sendspin’s Mac command-line player starts without extra audio software
articles.dek: The command-line player uses macOS audio services, fixing a launch failure on Macs without Homebrew’s PortAudio.
body: Sendspin’s C++ command-line player replaces its Mac audio dependency with the audio services built into macOS. The previous Mac binary could abort before playing anything if Homebrew’s PortAudio library was absent.

Chris tested the native output on a MacBook Pro with built-in speakers, a USB audio interface and a DisplayPort monitor, including playback in a Music Assistant group. Existing configurations that name a PortAudio output on a Mac need to select its CoreAudio equivalent instead; Linux keeps its existing audio options.

articles.title: Whole-home Hue motion zones stop breaking Home Assistant setup
articles.dek: A MotionAware zone covering the home could prevent the bridge’s binary sensors and switches from loading.
body: A Hue MotionAware zone covering the whole home could stop all binary sensors and switches for that bridge from loading in Home Assistant. The integration expected each zone to belong to a room or a conventional zone and failed when Hue pointed it at the whole home instead.
Franck Nijhof attaches those whole-home motion sensors and enable switches to the bridge when no room or zone device exists. Existing room-based MotionAware zones keep their association.

pullRequests.title: Fix Hue MotionAware entities for zones covering the whole home

articles.title: Home Assistant tracks UniFi backup batteries and remaining runtime
articles.dek: UniFi UPS devices expose charge, runtime and electrical readings, with model-specific voltage sensors.
body: UniFi UPS owners gain Home Assistant sensors for battery charge and remaining runtime, alongside output power, current, voltage and power factor. The readings make the backup power supply visible through the UniFi integration.
Jim Strang adds the readings. The UPS 2U Pro also exposes input voltage, while the UPS 2U exposes bypass voltage. The non-metered UPS 2U does not gain individual outlet-power readings.
